description: Hand-tuned menu sounds. A machine appears here only once its seven sounds have been written against that synth's own architecture and measured at one key: all seven stop on their own and are audibly distinct. Grouped by machine.

patches.name: cursor  [Bucket ONE]
patches.description: selection tick -- one narrow pulse at 4'

patches.name: confirm  [Bucket ONE]
patches.description: accept -- pulse and triangle stacked, a second DCO above

patches.name: cancel  [Bucket ONE]
patches.description: back out -- a lone sawtooth at 16', filter down

patches.name: error  [Bucket ONE]
patches.description: refused -- saw and pulse at 32' with noise, resonant and shut

patches.name: menu-open  [Bucket ONE]
patches.description: opening -- triangle and saw swelling, filter sweeping up

patches.name: menu-close  [Bucket ONE]
patches.description: closing -- the filter envelope inverted, so it shuts rather than opens

patches.name: equip  [Bucket ONE]
patches.description: cha-ching -- two narrow pulses at 4', detuned, resonant

patches.name: cursor  [FB-7999]
patches.description: the tick as the selection moves -- brightest wave, shortest decay

patches.name: confirm  [FB-7999]
patches.description: accept -- same blip with the pitch bending up into it

patches.name: cancel  [FB-7999]
patches.description: back out -- the darkest wave, pitch falling away

patches.name: error  [FB-7999]
patches.description: refused -- low, noisy and resonant, deliberately unpleasant

patches.name: menu-open  [FB-7999]
patches.description: opening a panel -- longer sweep up, a little delay behind it

patches.name: menu-close  [FB-7999]
patches.description: closing it -- the same gesture inverted

patches.name: equip  [FB-7999]
patches.description: equip or save -- a short bright clink

patches.name: cursor  [Fury68]
patches.description: selection tick -- one DCO at 4', pulse, 24 dB filter open

patches.name: confirm  [Fury68]
patches.description: accept -- square second DCO underneath, 12 dB filter

patches.name: cancel  [Fury68]
patches.description: back out -- sawtooth at 16', filter kept down

patches.name: error  [Fury68]
patches.description: refused -- PWM against a detuned square, resonant and shut

patches.name: menu-open  [Fury68]
patches.description: opening -- swells in through the ensemble, filter sweeping up

patches.name: menu-close  [Fury68]
patches.description: closing -- the same voice lower, chorus rather than ensemble

patches.name: equip  [Fury68]
patches.description: cha-ching -- pulse at 4' with a square a fifth up, resonant

patches.name: cursor  [Fury800]
patches.description: selection tick -- 2' alone, one oscillator

patches.name: confirm  [Fury800]
patches.description: accept -- 8' and 2' stacked, square

patches.name: cancel  [Fury800]
patches.description: back out -- 16' sawtooth alone, filter down

patches.name: error  [Fury800]
patches.description: refused -- both oscillators at 16' and 8' with noise, resonant

patches.name: menu-open  [Fury800]
patches.description: opening -- the full 8'+4'+2' stack swelling in, chorus behind

patches.name: menu-close  [Fury800]
patches.description: closing -- 16' and 8' only, shutting rather than opening

patches.name: equip  [Fury800]
patches.description: cha-ching -- 4' and 2' on both oscillators, detuned and resonant

patches.name: cursor  [Kern]
patches.description: selection tick -- square, fixed filter, short but pitched

patches.name: confirm  [Kern]
patches.description: accept -- a little envelope FM for bite

patches.name: cancel  [Kern]
patches.description: back out -- sawtooth, filter kept down

patches.name: error  [Kern]
patches.description: refused -- sync and heavy FM, filter shut, resonant

patches.name: menu-open  [Kern]
patches.description: opening -- swells in, filter sweeping up, chorus behind

patches.name: menu-close  [Kern]
patches.description: closing -- the same voice lower and duller

patches.name: equip  [Kern]
patches.description: cha-ching -- sync plus FM into a resonant open filter

patches.name: cursor  [MonoFury]
patches.description: selection tick -- one pulse oscillator at 2'

patches.name: confirm  [MonoFury]
patches.description: accept -- two pulses an octave apart, lightly detuned

patches.name: cancel  [MonoFury]
patches.description: back out -- a single sawtooth at 16', filter down

patches.name: error  [MonoFury]
patches.description: refused -- all four oscillators detuned into cross-modulation

patches.name: menu-open  [MonoFury]
patches.description: opening -- three oscillators swelling in, filter sweeping up

patches.name: menu-close  [MonoFury]
patches.description: closing -- two low oscillators, filter shutting

patches.name: equip  [MonoFury]
patches.description: cha-ching -- two high pulses through FM, resonant and open

patches.name: cursor  [MPS]
patches.description: selection tick -- brightest corner of the variation plane

patches.name: confirm  [MPS]
patches.description: accept -- the opposite corner, a little longer

patches.name: cancel  [MPS]
patches.description: back out -- damped, which on this synth also means darker

patches.name: error  [MPS]
patches.description: refused -- both variations wide open, morphing under it

patches.name: menu-open  [MPS]
patches.description: opening -- the longest the envelope reaches, morphing slowly

patches.name: menu-close  [MPS]
patches.description: closing -- mid-length, damped toward the dark corner

patches.name: equip  [MPS]
patches.description: cha-ching -- bright corner held a little longer, morph off

patches.name: cursor  [PECS]
patches.description: selection tick -- bank A raw, no filter path at all

patches.name: confirm  [PECS]
patches.description: accept -- banks A and B through the second pre-filter

patches.name: cancel  [PECS]
patches.description: back out -- bank C an octave down, organ+strings path

patches.name: error  [PECS]
patches.description: refused -- all three banks detuned through a resonant pre-filter

patches.name: menu-open  [PECS]
patches.description: opening -- banks A and B swelling through the chorus filter

patches.name: menu-close  [PECS]
patches.description: closing -- bank C through the VCF, shutting as it goes

patches.name: equip  [PECS]
patches.description: cha-ching -- bank A up an octave, raw and through a peaked VCF

patches.name: cursor  [Ragnarok2]
patches.description: selection tick -- a single square at 2', 24 dB lowpass

patches.name: confirm  [Ragnarok2]
patches.description: accept -- pulse at 8' and 2' together

patches.name: cancel  [Ragnarok2]
patches.description: back out -- sawtooth at 16', gentle 12 dB slope

patches.name: error  [Ragnarok2]
patches.description: refused -- multi and square at 16' with noise, driven hard

patches.name: menu-open  [Ragnarok2]
patches.description: opening -- saw at 8' and 4' with the interval rank, swelling

patches.name: menu-close  [Ragnarok2]
patches.description: closing -- highpass, which nothing else here offers

patches.name: equip  [Ragnarok2]
patches.description: cha-ching -- pulse at 4' and 2' over a square, synced and resonant

patches.name: cursor  [Tricent]
patches.description: selection tick -- Synthe alone, pulse at 4', instant attack so the click is part of it

patches.name: confirm  [Tricent]
patches.description: accept -- second oscillator detuned, filter envelope opening it

patches.name: cancel  [Tricent]
patches.description: back out -- sawtooth an octave down, filter kept shut

patches.name: error  [Tricent]
patches.description: refused -- low, narrow pulse, resonance up and the filter shut

patches.name: menu-open  [Tricent]
patches.description: opening a panel -- Strings swelling in through the ensemble, flanger behind it

patches.name: menu-close  [Tricent]
patches.description: closing it -- lower and duller, quicker in and slower out

patches.name: equip  [Tricent]
patches.description: equip or save -- a short bright clink

patches.name: fanfare  [Tricent]
patches.description: level up -- Brass and Synthe together, the machine's signature layered sound
